# NX-OS nxos qos fixtures

The `*_virtual.out`, `policy.out` and `invalid_port.out` files are SSH exec output from Nexus 9300v `Nexus 9300v, NX-OS 9.3(12)`, NX-OS 9.3(12), using the read-only lab account on 2026-11-19. `policy_switch-pair.out` is the same policy query on `nexus-peer-a`, NX-OS 9.3(12). The captures were processed with `tests/support/anonymize_fixture.py --check`. Capacity serials were supplied to the anonymizer as explicit serial fields. Commands and exit statuses are listed in the discovery evidence (private measurement record, not published).

- `queues_cisco.out` is the CLI response for Ethernet2/2 on the physical Nexus 9504 in the oversubscription example. The guide gives NX-OS 9.3(8) as its software baseline. [Cisco TAC buffer and congestion guide](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/docs/switches/nexus-9000-series-switches/217340-understand-the-tahusd-buffer-threshold-e.html).
- `pfc_cisco.out` is the PFC walkthrough output in the Nexus 9000 RoCE guide. The publisher's truncation marker is retained and the source does not specify the exact build. [Cisco RoCE white paper](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/td/docs/dcn/whitepapers/roce-storage-implementation-over-nxos-vxlan-fabrics.html).
- `tcam_cisco.out` is the CLI output of the internal alias in the 9.3(x) guide. The 9.3(x) show-command grammar lists the public and internal prefixes for the same utilization table. The lab confirmed that the public command and the capacity subcommand emit the same table format. [Cisco DevNet NX-API REST SDK 9.3(x)](https://developer.cisco.com/docs/cisco-nexus-3000-and-9000-series-nx-api-rest-sdk-user-guide-and-api-reference-release-9-3x/querying-tcam-resource-utilization/).
